node.statement: The registered coordinate-sum inner-product display makes C^n tensor S_{P,Q} the finite Hilbertian direct sum of n copies of the now-complete Euclidean space S_{P,Q}; it is therefore complete.  For normed E and Banach F, B(E,F) is Banach: an operator-norm Cauchy sequence converges pointwise in F, and the pointwise limit is bounded and is the operator-norm limit.  Taking (E,F)=(C^n,C^n tensor S_{P,Q}) and (C^n tensor S_{P,Q},C^n) proves that both actual targets are Banach.
